ai_summary: Camera digit OCR for card/bank numbers. Classical CV pipeline: NV21 frame -> ARGB -> rotate/crop in Java, then libdigit_ocr.so: rgbToGray -> adaptive threshold -> connected-component digit segmentation (1:3.5 aspect, slant correction) -> 20x32 grayscale patch -> 144-dim HOG (binarise >80, 4x4 cells x 9 orientation bins, counts/40) -> LIBSVM RBF C-SVC (10-class digit model gamma=2.0, plus a 2-class gate model gamma=0.5) -> digit string with per-digit confidence and top-3 candidates. Both model assets are plain LIBSVM text files, fully parsed; the reimplementation uses the real weights and matches the shipped library numerically.

features.name: Digit OCR (card/bank number capture)
pipeline: a.b.a.b Camera1 preview delivers NV21 byte[] frames on a HandlerThread
a.b.a.d: Y plane -> ARGB int[] via (Y&0xff)*0x10101|0xFF000000, Bitmap ARGB_8888
rotate by cameraMode, crop to the mask rectangle mapped into preview coordinates
SegDigitInBinaryImg: FindDigitConnectedReigon -> FindDigitTargetRect(aspect 1.0..3.5) -> RANSAC line / CorrectBiasAngle -> SetDigitMatVector
each segmented glyph normalised to a 20x32 grayscale patch
CFEATURE_HOG::ExtractGradientOrientation(patch,20,32): binarise>80, gx/gy backward differences, atan2 orientation, 4x4 cells x 9 bins of 40deg, counts/40 -> 144 float32
CDigitalOCR::Predict: svm_predict_probability(Digital_OCR_svm_9.model) -> argmax digit, confidence=int(prob*100), plus 2nd/3rd candidate when prob>0.1 (OCR_STR{digit,conf})
CDigitalOCR::PredictNegPos: svm_predict_probability(Digital_OCR_svm_2.model) -> binary gate used by MainOCR::trimBadDigit
MainOCR assembles the digit string, applies the digit-count range (default 15..19) and frame-result/confidence logic; Java reads it via nativegetDigitResultString
features.notes: Whole chain decompiled (sources/) and the native classifier stage verified numerically against the shipped arm64 library under qemu-aarch64: HOG exact, decision values 6.7e-8, probabilities 4.7e-11, full pipeline recognised a synthetic '1234' card image and the JAX reimplementation reproduced the same string from the vendor's own 20x32 patches.

models.format: LIBSVM text model (svm_save_model), c_svc + rbf, CRLF

io.input: 144 float32 HOG features (libsvm indices 1..144; only 1..142 active in the support vectors)
io.output: 10 class probabilities (labels 0..9), argmax digit, confidence = int(prob*100)

ops: rbf kernel exp(-2.0*||x-sv||^2) against 1076 support vectors
one-vs-one decision values (45 pairs, rho offsets)
models.verification: vendor-qemu: HOG exact; decision values max|diff| 6.7e-08; probabilities max|diff| 4.7e-11 for 6 vectors; JAX reproduces '1234' from the vendor's own normalised patches; reimpl/verify.txt exit 0

models.format: LIBSVM text model (svm_save_model), c_svc + rbf, CRLF

io.input: 144 float32 HOG features of a 20x32 candidate glyph

ops: rbf kernel exp(-0.5*||x-sv||^2) against 545 support vectors
models.verification: vendor-qemu probabilities max|diff| 4.7e-11 on 6 feature vectors; reimpl/verify.txt exit 0

reimplementation.limitations: Classifier stage only (HOG + LIBSVM with the real shipped weights), which is where all learned parameters live. The upstream segmentation stage (rgbToGray formats, adaptiveThreshold window/offset, FindDigitTargetRect/HOG-cell geometry constants, DP split points) is documented but not reimplemented; inputs are 20x32 grayscale glyph patches (28x28/32x32 accepted via nearest-neighbour resampling). Polarity of the binary gate model (label 0 vs 1 meaning) is not provable from the binary.

unknowns: adaptiveThreshold implementation (window size, offset C, mean vs Gaussian) is a local, non-exported function; only its (gray,&bin,w,h) call signature is recovered.
rgbToGray coefficients per image format (1..4) are not recovered; the Java path always passes format 4 (RGBA_8888).
DigitSegment geometric constants beyond the (1.0, 3.5) aspect bounds, and the exact DP/projection-histogram split logic in FindSegPointFromHistogram / FindSegPointDP.
svm_load_cvt_model's internal pre-conversion is not decoded (verified numerically identical to svm_load_model).
Semantics of the binary model's label 0/1 in PredictNegPos (which side means 'is a digit') cannot be determined from the binary alone.
The library writes a debug dump to a hard-coded path 'D:\\123.txt' while loading models (leftover from the vendor build); harmless on Android.

data_pipelines.name: Voucher/card code digit OCR (camera -> NV21 -> mask crop -> libdigit_ocr HOG+SVM -> UI)

trigger.ui: com.xiaomi.payment.channel.VoucherFragment.j0() (camera button R.id.camera_btn on the voucher / 'Mi Coin card password' screen)
trigger.request: CameraIntentData(R.id.voucher_edit=2131362538, prompt=mibi_scan_prompt_voucher, allowedLengths={o.l.m..o.l.n}) into bundle key IEntry.f3559b='arguments'
trigger.dispatch: com.xiaomi.payment.entry.a.a(String, Fragment, Bundle, 31) -> provider lookup -> com.mibi.ocr.entry.DigitOcrEntry.a(IEntry.a, bundle, 31) -> Intent(CaptureActivity) + extra 'payment_fragment_arguments'
trigger.lifecycle: a.b.a.c (DigitOCRManager) states NULL/INIT/PREVIEWING/PAUSED; camera opened in h(), released in i(); native MainOCR created per recognizer in a.b.a.d.a(Context) and never destroyed

transport.camera_api: android.hardware.Camera (Camera1), opened on the UI thread
transport.format: NV21 (default; setPreviewFormat is never called); only the first w*h bytes (Y plane) are read
transport.frame_size: selected preview size: exact (long,short) match to the screen if available, else the size minimising |int(long/short) - screenLong/screenShort| (sizes sorted by area desc, first best cached) - note int division truncates the candidate aspect
transport.camera_mode: (450 - displayRotationDegrees) mod 360 (portrait=90, ROTATION_90=0, ROTATION_180=270, ROTATION_270=180); tablets may override with (physicalOrientation+90) mod 360 via OrientationEventListener
transport.threads: frames arrive on the main thread; RecognizeController owns HandlerThread 'decode'
transport.queue: depth 1 - one frame in flight (processing flag + hasMessages(1)); a frame arriving while busy is dropped and a new one is requested
transport.cadence: one frame per request; re-arm 300 ms; auto-focus mode retries autoFocus every 300 ms and captures immediately on success
transport.ownership: framework-allocated byte[] per one-shot callback, passed by reference through Message.obj (no copy), read-only

mask_and_coordinates.mask_rect: centred 350dp x 65dp window (318dp x 59dp @xxxhdpi), width falls back to 95% of the screen width if narrower; PreviewMaskView is a pure overlay (DST_OUT scrim + animated scan line)
mask_and_coordinates.portrait_mapping: left'=left*previewH/screenW; right'=right*previewH/screenW; top'=top*previewW/screenH; bottom'=bottom*previewW/screenH (integer division, no clamping)
mask_and_coordinates.crop_space: mask rect is mapped into preview coordinates and applied AFTER rotating the full frame bitmap by cameraMode, so the rotated frame is previewH x previewW in portrait
mask_and_coordinates.example: 1080x2400 screen + 1920x1080 preview + 3x density -> crop x=1050 px wide, y=156 px high

preprocessing: Y plane -> ARGB int[]: dst = ((src & 0xFF) * 0x10101) | 0xFF000000 (grey replicated to R,G,B)
rotate by cameraMode via Matrix.setRotate(cameraMode, w/2f, h/2f), filtered
crop at mapped Point(rect.left, rect.top) with size (rect.width, rect.height)
copyPixelsToBuffer into ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(w*h*4) (RGBA byte order), flip()
nativeSetImage(handle, buffer, w, h, 4) -> MainOCR::setImage stores the borrowed pointer
native: rgbToGray(fmt=4) -> adaptiveThreshold -> connected components -> FindDigitTargetRect(1.0,3.5) -> RANSAC/CleanBiasAngle -> 20x32 grey patches
CFEATURE_HOG::ExtractGradientOrientation: binarise >80, backward gx/gy, atan2, 4x4 cells x 9 bins (40 deg), /40 -> 144 float32

model_invocation.model_loading: XiaoMIDigitOCR copies both assets into filesDir and calls nativeBeginProcess(handle, svm9Path, svm2Path) -> CDigitalOCR::LoadModel -> svm_load_model x2

jni.nativeBeginProcess: (JLjava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/String;)Z @0x14840, GetStringUTFChars -> beginProcess -> ReleaseStringUTFChars, returns true unconditionally
jni.nativeSetImage: (JLjava/nio/ByteBuffer;III)Z @0x148f0, GetDirectBufferAddress -> MainOCR::setImage (stores borrowed pointer, no copy/global ref); false if fmt not in 1..4 or pointer NULL
jni.nativeRecogDigit: (J[I)I @0x1497c, recogdigitOCR -> process_OneImg; GetIntArrayElements copy of count digits from +0x7d8, Release(0); returns count
jni.nativeEndProcess: not exported for com.xiaomi.payment.camera.XiaoMIDigitOCR (only legacy Java_com_xiaomicode_digitocr_DigitOCR_nativeEndProcess @0x14948) - dead code, native object leaks

model_invocation.buffer_ownership: Java allocates a direct ByteBuffer per frame; native stores the raw pointer without pinning/copying and reads it in the same synchronous setImage/recogDigit sequence on the 'decode' thread
model_invocation.threading: all JNI calls on the single HandlerThread 'decode'; MainOCR is thread-confined
model_invocation.cancellation: RecognizeController.d() removeMessages(1); DigitOCRManager.i() -> f.d() + camera.release(); no native abort for an in-flight frame

postprocessing.per_digit: svm_predict_probability(svm_9) -> argmax digit, confidence=int(prob*100), top-3 candidates with prob>0.1
postprocessing.gate: CDigitalOCR::PredictNegPos(svm_2) used by MainOCR::trimBadDigit(...,60,...) as a keep/drop tie-breaker
postprocessing.acceptance: XiaoMIDigitOCR.c(): nativegetmeanConfidence() > 80 (set via b(80)) AND digit count in the caller-supplied whitelist; a.b.a.d returns nativegetDigitResultString() when the gate passes, otherwise ''
postprocessing.pan_lengths: native default 15..19 (MainOCR ctor), overridden by nativesetDigitRange(min,max) from CameraIntentData.h (voucher code window m..n)

consumer.path: decode thread -> RecognizeController callback -> DigitOCRManager.b -> CaptureFragment$e.a(String) -> UI Handler -> CaptureFragment.h(str): R.id.result TextView, buttons visible, preview paused
consumer.empty_result: request next frame (j.a()), UI keeps scanning
consumer.confirm: CaptureFragment$b: bundle[key=Integer.toString(R.id.voucher_edit)='2131362538'] = TextView text -> fragment result (-1) -> VoucherFragment.a(31,-1,intent) -> FormattableEditText.setText (setMaxLength(n))
consumer.validation: VoucherFragment$c: trim -> if empty or len<m or len>n -> Toast mibi_voucher_error_password; else presenter.a(code) (redemption submission)
consumer.privacy: no frame or digit persistence in this path; only writes are the two SVM models copied to app-private filesDir and the vendor's impossible debug dump D:\123.txt; native logs only 'ocrdebug len=%d'

failure_paths: camera feature missing or incognito mode -> DigitOcrEntry.a(Context) false -> camera button hidden
CAMERA permission denied -> BaseFragment i0() -> H() (close)
Camera.open() failure -> Toast mibi_camera_open_failed ('相机打开失败') -> H()
model assets missing/copy failure -> IllegalStateException('Digital_OCR_svm*.models are not provided rightly') on the decode thread
native model load failure -> logged ('model load fail') but JNI returns true, so Java proceeds
no digits / mean confidence <= 80 / count outside whitelist -> empty result, keep scanning
mapped crop outside the rotated frame -> Bitmap.createBitmap throws on the decode thread (no fallback) [inferred]
orientation change while previewing (tablet) -> cameraMode updated but not re-applied until the next camera open [confirmed code]
open_questions: adaptiveThreshold window/offset and rgbToGray coefficients (segmentation stage) remain unrecovered
whether +0xe20 is an average or minimum confidence (field name says mean; estimateFrameMinConf/AvgConf both write neighbouring fields)
semantics of the binary gate model labels
exact on-device preview size / density combination (formulas are exact, the concrete numbers depend on the device)
